hint.tool.blur: Softens pixels under the brush. Stroke again to strengthen
hint.tool.contour: Draw an outline, it is filled on release
hint.tool.curve: Drag a line, then drag twice to bend it
hint.tool.ellipse: Shift: circle, Ctrl: from center, Alt: turn it (Shift snaps 15°), Space: move while drawing
hint.tool.ellipseMarquee: Drag to select an ellipse. Ctrl draws from the center
hint.tool.eraser: Left erases. Right replaces the primary color with the secondary
hint.tool.fill: Fill an area. Turn off "Contiguous" to replace a color everywhere
hint.tool.gradient: Drag across an area to fill it with a primary → secondary ramp. Shift snaps the angle, Ctrl fills around the middle
hint.tool.hand: Pan the canvas. Hold Space with any tool
hint.tool.lasso: Draw a freehand outline to select
hint.tool.line: Shift snaps to pixel-friendly angles, Ctrl draws from the center, Space moves it
hint.tool.marquee: Drag to select. Shift adds, Shift+Alt or right button subtracts. Drag inside to move, handles scale and rotate
hint.tool.move: Moves the layer (or the selection). Ctrl picks the layer under the cursor
hint.tool.pencil: Left: primary, right: secondary. Shift draws a straight line from the last point
hint.tool.picker: Left: pick primary, right: pick secondary. Hold Alt with any tool
hint.tool.polyLasso: Drag edges, click without moving (or Enter) to close
hint.tool.polygon: Drag edges, click without moving (or Enter) to finish
hint.tool.rect: Shift: square, Ctrl: from center, Alt: turn it (Shift snaps 15°), Space: move while drawing
hint.tool.slice: Drag on empty space to make a slice or pick slices; drag a slice to move it, its edge to resize. Double click for properties
hint.tool.spray: Hold to spray dots around the cursor
hint.tool.text: Click where the text should start and type. Enter applies, Esc cancels; drag the text afterwards to place it
hint.tool.zoom: Click to zoom in, right click to zoom out, drag sideways for smooth zoom
